GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5l off, much the same turn, Straightened Up 4l off, running on 1 length off 100m, kept finding the line, took lead late and drew clear # had run/too good
Jumped Ok well back Settled Down 3 Wide 9th 8 Lengths 800m 7th 7 Lengths home turn 6th Middle Of Track Kept Going Ok Straight # fair effort/run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after straightening was ridden out across a number of sets of heels to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn , taken off heels Straightening Up , couldn't come on in Straight # no excuses

Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide With Cover rounding turn and Four Wide Straightening Up , ran on down centre of track, hit Lead 200m and kept going to post # solid win
Jumped okay & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths on fence, railed up to 4.5 Lengths turning, improved only a length along fence in Straight # no real excuses
Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Settled Down Mid Field 7th 8 Lengths 800m 7th 10 Lengths home turn 7th Under Pressure Middle Of Track Kept Going Ok Straight # one paced run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped out fine. Settled Down Two Wide 7th, 6 Lengths @ 950m. Off Mid-Field into Straight . Just Held Ground Off Mid-Field to line (vetted - cardiac arrhythmia) # cardiac arrhythmia
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination of the mare revealed to have cardiac arrhythmia for the first time. Cleared to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out then hampered (-1.5 lengths) and Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn 2 Lengths 3 Wide , steered a lane past centre of track Straightening Up and kept trying in Straight # slow out/fair late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and hampered shortly after.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 3.5 Lengths rail turning, steered centre of track Straightening Up and picked up a length or So in the run home # battled on fairly

Jumped only fairly missing start 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down 4 Lengths 3 Wide , made no ground to Turn then steered across Straightening Up 3 lanes off the outside rail, Made Some Ground in Straight # slow out/ran fair
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader 1 length. 2nd turn. ran on strongly # strong win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier, worked forward to settle outside the leader under minimal pressure.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly and Settled Down 6 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved a couple of places in Straight while holding ground to the runaway winner. [Stewards: Not raced 150+ days. Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A pre-race veterinary examination of the mare, which had not raced for in excess of 150 days, passed it fit to race.
